description: Find the YogaMag timed routine for a goal and the minutes the person has: the longest one that fits, or the shortest if none is that short. Returns the routine as published, with its steps, who should skip or modify it, and the follow-along link. If the person avoids the floor, kneeling or weight on the wrists, pass avoid and each step is checked. YogaMag has routines only for the goals listed; if none matches what was asked (for example sleep), say there is no such routine yet and use search_content instead of picking the nearest goal.

avoid.description: Optional. What the person cannot or does not want to do: floor = cannot get down to the floor, kneeling = cannot kneel, wrists = no weight on the wrists

goal.description: One of: morning = Wake up and move (Morning routines that work every major joint); desk = A desk break (In your chair, or standing at your desk); strength = Strength and tight hips (Stretches plus holds such as Plank, Chair Pose and Bridge); after-run = After a run (Slow holds for calves, quads, hips and hamstrings); gentle = Stiff and want it gentle (In bed, or seated and chair-supported); sleep = Wind down at night (Slow floor poses and breathing before bed); relaxation = Slow down and relax (Seated breathing and gentle movement, no floor needed); flexibility = Loosen tight hips and hamstrings (Slow holds for hips, hamstrings and back); no-floor = Can't get down to the floor (Seated, standing or holding a chair)

level.description: Optional. Only routines up to this level are considered. YogaMag routines are Beginner or Intermediate.

minutes.description: Minutes the person has; the nearest option that is not longer than their time

name: find_routine
title: Find a timed routine
